name: Side outlet valves and annulus access
function: The small gate valves on the side outlets of the casing spools and tubing head that give access to each annulus for monitoring, testing, and pumping.

tabs.overview: Each casing spool has two outlets, one usually fitted with a valve and gauge and the other with a valve and a blind flange or a VR plug. During fracturing the intermediate and surface annuli are monitored for pressure change; the outlets are also where the annulus is bled, tested, or filled.
tabs.engineering: API 6A gate valves, commonly 2-1/16 in. bore, rated to the spool pressure, flanged or studded; a needle valve and gauge on the outlet.
tabs.safety: Outlet valves are opened slowly; annulus fluid may be gas-cut or contain H2S on some wells. Never leave an outlet open to atmosphere unattended.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Monitors and wind indicators per the site plan when the well can flow sour gas.
